name: local-llm
description: Access locally-hosted OSS LLMs (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, any OpenAI-compatible runtime) as MCP tools.
long_description: Exposes whatever models the local runtime is serving (read live from /api/tags) via three tools: list_models, local_chat, and local_compare. Pairs well with cloud endpoints for a tiered workflow: small/fast local models for high-frequency mechanical tasks, big cloud models for heavy reasoning. Resolves the runtime host from LOCAL_LLM_HOST (preferred), OPENAI_BASE_URL, or OLLAMA_HOST, defaulting to http://127.0.0.1:11434 — so the same shim works against Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, llama.cpp server, or any OpenAI-compatible local runtime.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List locally-installed OSS models served by the local runtime.

tools.name: local_chat
tools.description: Single-model completion against any installed local model.

tools.name: local_compare
tools.description: Ensemble fan-out across multiple local models for cross-checking.

host.title: Local runtime host URL
host.description: Base URL of the local OpenAI-compatible runtime (Ollama default: http://127.0.0.1:11434).
